question.text: Essential Commodities Act applies to commodity trading in which context?

answer.text: Commodities trading is subject to legal risk from local/regional/national regulations such as the Essential Commodities Act
It only applies to commodity derivatives on exchanges
It applies only to international commodity trade

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook treats the Essential Commodities Act as an example of the local/regional/national regulation that creates legal risk for commodities trading, alongside historical controls and prohibitions on some commodity trading. The Trap: The Act has not been fully repealed, is not limited to exchange-traded derivatives, and is not restricted to international trade. Note: The pages checked do not detail the Act's specific production/supply/distribution powers or describe sudden government-order trading bans, so those claims are intentionally omitted.
